overview.short: Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary spans 65 kilometers of the River Ganga from Sultanganj to Kahalgaon in Bhagalpur, the only designated protected sanctuary for endangered Gangetic dolphins in Asia.
overview.description: Protecting the national aquatic animal of India (Platanista gangetica), this river sanctuary shelters over 300 freshwater Gangetic dolphins (Susu), smooth-coated otters, gharials, and endangered Indian skimmers. The region is rich in heritage, including the 8th-century Vikramshila Ancient Buddhist University, the rock-island temple of Ajgaibinath at Sultanganj, and the Bateshwar Sthan cliff carvings.
features: Asia’s Only Protected River Dolphin Sanctuary (65 km)
Vikramshila Ancient Buddhist University Ruins (8th CE)
Bateshwar Sthan Rock Sculptures & Kahalgaon Islands
overview.about: A breathtaking river safari paradise where playful Gangetic dolphins breach alongside ancient rock monasteries, granite islands, and silk-weaving heritage.

howToReach.roadNote: Connected via NH-80 from Munger, Bhagalpur, and Kahalgaon.

topPlaces.name: Gangetic Dolphin River Safari (Kahalgaon / Barari)
topPlaces.description: Motorized and country boat safaris along the Ganga to observe endangered Gangetic dolphins surfacing and leaping.

topPlaces.name: Vikramshila Ancient University Ruins (Antichak)
topPlaces.description: Excavated 8th-century Pala royal Buddhist university featuring a massive cruciform brick stupa and 52 monasteries.

image.alt: Vikramshila Ancient University Ruins (Antichak) in Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Ajgaibinath Rock Island Temple (Sultanganj)
topPlaces.description: Spectacular Shiva temple perched on a granite rock island in the Ganga, starting point of the 100km Kanwar Yatra to Deoghar.

image.alt: Ajgaibinath Rock Island Temple (Sultanganj) in Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Bateshwar Sthan Cliff Sculptures & Hermitage
topPlaces.description: Scenic river bluff adorned with 6th-century rock-cut reliefs of Hindu deities and ancient hermitage caves.

image.alt: Bateshwar Sthan Cliff Sculptures & Hermitage in Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Kahalgaon Three Granite Islands (Teen Pahar)
topPlaces.description: Trio of picturesque rocky granite islands rising dramatically in the middle of the Ganga river channel.

image.alt: Kahalgaon Three Granite Islands (Teen Pahar), Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary

topPlaces.name: Kuppa Ghat Maharshi Mehi Ashram & Caves
topPlaces.description: Lush riverside spiritual ashram featuring ancient subterranean meditation caves used by Sant Maharshi Mehi Paramhans.

image.alt: Kuppa Ghat Maharshi Mehi Ashram & Caves in Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary, Bihar

topPlaces.name: Champanagar Jain Teerth (Birthplace of Vasupujya)
topPlaces.description: Sacred Jain pilgrimage temple marking the birthplace and salvation of 12th Tirthankar Lord Vasupujya.

image.alt: Champanagar Jain Teerth (Birthplace of Vasupujya), Vikramshila Gangetic Dolphin Sanctuary

topPlaces.name: Bhagalpur Tussar Silk Weaving Quarter
